message: I just stumbled across this site and I am so pleased, I now live in the UK and my partner is in MD in MCAC and we have been suffering terribly over the last year with calls and T-netix refuses to listen to me when I call them. I have spent hours on the phone to them at a very high cost to me, the automated service asks for a 3 digit code which I don't have.  I send a money order each month to cover the costs of our calls plus calls he has to make to his sister in another state. I have so many emails from them and they seem to be about the same thing although I explain in depth what we are going through, we are meant to have a 30 minute call on a fixed rate, this call never lasts longer than 20 minutes in total if we are lucky, sometimes we get a dropped call after 3 minutes and this can happen up to 5 times in a day.  I then tell him to not call me back as this is costing us to much. He will get charged for the full amount. T-Netix has ripped me off so much tonight I didn't know where to turn to so looked online for answers.  The institution does not have any complaints forms to hand out, but having said that they don't even have remedy forms either,  does anyone know where I can download a complaints form for T-netix so I can send it to him and others on his pod ?  I would really appreciate this as I am running out of patience over here.  This facility is so slow in doing things, this is costing me a fortune. If anyone has any advice they can give me I would really be sooooooooooooooooo grateful.
